root_cause: The NHSBoxexclusive module only responds to click events, so pressing Space on the exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox does not trigger the clearing of other symptom checkboxes.
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener to the exclusive checkbox that manually unchecks other checkboxes in the same group when it is checked via keyboard.

edits.after:
<script type="module">
import { initCheckboxes } from './packages/nhsuk-frontend/src/nhsuk/components/checkboxes/checkboxes.js'
initCheckboxes()
// Fix exclusive behavior for keyboard
const symptomsNone = document.getElementById('symptoms-none');
if (symptomsNone) {
  symptomsNone.addEventListener('change', () => {
    if (symptomsNone.checked) {
      document.querySelectorAll('input[name^="symptoms["]:not(#symptoms-none)').forEach(el => {
        el.checked = false;
        el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
      });
    }
  });
}
</script>

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now clear symptom selections by choosing 'No symptoms', satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order requirements.
functional_risks: Duplicate listeners if the script is executed multiple times.
Overly broad selector could affect other forms if reused, but limited to symptoms form.
Manual dispatch of change events may interfere with other listeners expecting native events.
verification_requirements: Check that selecting 'No symptoms' via Space after checking cough and fever clears those checkboxes.
Verify that mouse click on 'No symptoms' still works as before.
Ensure that checking other symptom boxes after 'No symptoms' does not re‑check the 'No symptoms' box.
Confirm that the form data for symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] is empty when 'No symptoms' is checked.
